a Pendle TWAP of this PT's pool (PT against its underlying)

tracks.basis: D115: a feed reads the market it tracks (a Pendle TWAP its PT's pool, a 'SYM / USD' feed that pair): a move of that market moves the reading

base-feed.basis: Morpho ChainlinkOracleV2: price = base vault x base feeds / (quote vault x quote feeds); a base feed reading m x moves the price by m

base-feed-reading.basis: a base feed following its market moves the oracle with it

oracle-misreport.basis: a market liquidates on its oracle's reading

oracle-reading.basis: a market liquidates on its oracle's reading

collateral-tracked-by-feed.basis: D115: the oracle reads its collateral's market through a tracked feed (rule tracks), not here; the collateral's worth still moves

collateral-constant.basis: a constant-price oracle ignores the market: a fall liquidates nobody and leaves insolvent debt

collateral-value.basis: D115: a move inherited from an underlying changes the collateral's worth; no oracle reading its own market or its accounting rate sees it

collateral-exit.basis: D113: liquidations can sell only what the collateral's market absorbs

pendle-underlying.basis: D115: a PT is worth its underlying at maturity, so a move of the underlying's market changes the PT's worth; the pool prices PT against the underlying (PT_TO_ASSET / PT_TO_SY), so the pool price, which a Pendle oracle reads, does not move

pendle-underlying-exit.basis: PT liquidators sell the underlying they receive: if its market cannot absorb it, the PT's liquidations cannot complete

pendle-pt-value.basis: a move inherited through the pool passes on to the PT

pendle-pt-exit.basis: the underlying's exit limit passes on to the PT

liquidation-sale.basis: liquidators offer the seized collateral for sale into its market

pt-onward.basis: a PT sold into its pool comes out as underlying

pool-onward.basis: liquidators sell that underlying for dollars

supplier.basis: a market's loss is shared by its suppliers pro rata to their supply
